Help & Reference

Getting Started

1. Create a report
Click + New Report in the sidebar. Set your title, author, date, category, and pick a color/font.
2. Add blocks
Use the buttons at the bottom of the editor to add content blocks in any order. Drag blocks to reorder.
3. View your report
View Report renders a printable academic document. View as Story creates an interactive scrollytelling experience.

Block Types

Aa Heading
Section titles. Auto-numbered in report view. Creates chapters in story mode and entries in the table of contents.
☰ Text
Free-form narrative. Supports inline formatting (see below). First paragraph after a heading gets a drop cap in the report.
# Metrics
KPI cards with label, value, and change indicator. Add as many rows as needed. Renders as a card grid.
▦ Data Table
Flexible table with add/remove rows and columns. Also created automatically by CSV and Excel imports.
! Callout
Highlighted box for key insights. Types: Note (blue), Warning (orange), Success (green), Critical (red). Set a custom label.
✓ Checklist
Task list with checkboxes, owner, and due date fields. Checked items render with strikethrough in the report.
• Timeline
Simple date + milestone list. Good for quick overviews and project phases.
⋮ Chronology
Detailed event log with date, title, description, tag, and color per entry. Renders as a visual vertical timeline.
“ Quote
Pull quote with source attribution. Renders as an editorial-style blockquote with borders in the report.
▶ Toggle
Collapsible section with a title and hidden content. Click the arrow to expand/collapse in the editor.
Image
Upload, drag & drop, or paste an image from clipboard. Add an optional caption. Size control: choose Full (100%), Large (75%), Medium (50%), or Small (25%) width. Sized images are centered in the report.
Profile
Biographical profile card for a person. Includes photo, name, aliases, DOB, nationality, role, organization, and status (Active / Deceased / Unknown / Detained). Add phone numbers, email accounts, and social media links with labels. Use Custom Identifiers to add any field you need (passport #, badge #, case file, etc.). Includes biography, key relationships (with type: Associate, Family, Colleague, etc.), and notes. Renders as a professional card in the report with photo header, contact grid, and expandable sections.
▤ Media + Text
Side-by-side layout with an image and text. Toggle image position (left or right) and choose image width (Small 25%, Medium 40%, Large 60%). Text supports inline formatting. Great for placing illustrations, maps, or photos alongside narrative content.
Chart
Interactive data chart. Choose type: Bar, Line, Scatter, Area, or Horizontal Bar. Enter data in CSV format (Label,Value per line). Add an optional caption. Charts render via D3.js in all views.
Σ Equation
LaTeX-rendered mathematical equations. Type LaTeX syntax in the editor and see a live preview. Includes a quick-reference toolbar with common symbols: Greek letters, fractions, square roots, summation, integrals, matrices, and more. Renders via KaTeX in all views.
▮ Gantt Chart
Visual project timeline with tasks, start/end dates, progress percentage, and color coding. Renders as an interactive horizontal bar chart using D3. Shows completion shading per task.
■ Progress Tracker
Track project milestones with planned vs. actual dates, completion percentage with visual progress bars, and status (On Track / At Risk / Delayed / Complete / Cancelled). Color-coded status badges.
Audio
Upload MP3/WAV/OGG (max 3MB). Embeds an HTML5 player. Add a caption.
Video
Link/reference mode — paste a video URL. Does not embed the file itself to save storage.
PDF
Upload a small PDF (max 5MB) to embed, or paste a URL. Renders in an iframe viewer in the editor.
File Ref
Reference any external file by name, type, and path/URL. For large files like datasets or videos.
Sources
Research source tracker with categorization: Public Record, News/Media, Social Media, Interview/Human, Government/Official, Academic, Website, Document, Other. Each source has a name, description, URL/location, date obtained, and notes. Use for tracking where information comes from during research and investigations.
[1] References
Structured academic citation list: Author, Title, Publication, Year, URL. Auto-numbered. Renders in academic citation format. Used by the Citation Cross-Ref auto-generate feature.
Semantic Links
Link blocks to each other using wiki-style syntax in any text field:
[[Block Title]] — link to any block by its heading or title
@Name — link to a Profile block by name
[src:1] — link to reference #1
[fn:1] — link to footnote #1
[[Report Name > Block Title]] — cross-report link (synthesis reports only)
Type @ or [[ in any text area to open the link picker. Click any link in the editor or story view to see a quick preview popover. In the PDF report, links jump directly to their target, and a Quick Reference appendix lists every linked block with a summary card. Profile blocks have an optional Summary field to customize what appears in previews; other blocks auto-generate from their content.

Synthesis Reports

◇ Synthesis Reports
A special report type that draws findings from multiple source reports to build a formal conclusion. Think of it like a graduate thesis referencing multiple studies, or an intelligence assessment drawing on multiple source reports. Click ◇ + Synthesis in the sidebar to create one. Synthesis reports have a purple diamond icon and border to distinguish them from regular reports.
⚙ Link Source Reports
Use the Link Sources button in the meta bar (visible only on synthesis reports) to attach source reports. Linked sources appear as cards in a strip above the editor and become available to the link picker as [[Report > Block]] cross-report references.
⚜ Argument Schema Block
A structured block for formal argumentation. Maps individual claims to subordination codes (MP, S, EC, etc.), assigns premise/conclusion roles, states the implicit question being answered, lists rival conclusions, and characterizes the overall structure (convergent, linked, chain, or mixed). On synthesis reports, you can also use ◇ + Claim from Source to import a claim directly from a linked source block with auto-populated cross-reference.
¹ Footnotes
Numbered endnotes. Use [^1], [^2] in text blocks to create inline superscript references. Notes collect at the bottom of the report.
☷ Columns
Two-column side-by-side text layout. Each column supports inline formatting. Good for comparisons, pros/cons, or scenario analysis.
— Divider
Visual separator. Renders as three dots (• • •) in the report.

Text Formatting

*italic*italic
**bold**bold
***bold italic***bold italic
`code`code
[^1]Footnote marker → superscript 1

Imports

{ } JSON
Import previously exported reports. Merges with existing reports (no duplicates).
csv CSV
Paste comma or tab-separated data. First row becomes table headers.
md Markdown
Paste markdown text. Headings (#, ##, ###) become heading blocks. Paragraphs become text blocks. > becomes quotes.
xlsx Excel
Import .xlsx/.xls files. Each sheet becomes a table block. Multi-sheet files get a heading per sheet.

Report Settings

Color
8 presets: Teal, Sage, Navy, Plum, Copper, Slate, Forest, Wine. Affects the cover page, headings, accents, and metrics.
Font
8 presets: Editorial, Classic, Modern Sans, Academic, Elegant, Technical, Minimal, Journal. Each pairs a heading, body, and UI font.
Size
Small (0.85×), Medium (1×), Large (1.15×), X-Large (1.3×). Scales all report text proportionally.
Status
Draft, In Review, Final, Archived. Shown on the cover page and sidebar badge.

Views

View Report
Static, print-ready document with cover page, table of contents, auto-numbered sections, and endnotes. Use Print / Save PDF to export.
View as Story
Interactive scrollytelling mode. Full-screen hero, fade-in animations, chapter navigation dots, and a progress bar.

Tips

• All data auto-saves to your browser (localStorage).
• Export JSON regularly as a backup.
• Paste images anywhere with Ctrl/Cmd+V.
• Drag block headers to reorder.
• Press Escape to close any overlay.
• Use the Link Chart tool to create network diagrams, then import the .json or export as PNG and add via Image block.
• Use Image Size to control width (25%–100%) in the report.
• Use Media+Text to place images side-by-side with narrative text.
• Use Profile blocks to build biographical profiles with photos, contact info, social media, and custom identifier fields.
• Profile Custom Identifiers can hold any label/value pair you need — passport numbers, case file IDs, badge numbers, etc.
